# Priscilla Grant

[Queen’s Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy)

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla Grant is a pale, spiritual-looking maiden with a fair and golden appearance. When dressed up, she wears silk attire.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Despite her pale and spiritual appearance, Priscilla Grant is known for her lively disposition. She is full of fun, mischief, and a penchant for playing pranks.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- full to the brim of mischief and pranks and fun  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), building a friendship with her during their time as classmates. She joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) on a spring picnic walk where they named [Crystal Lake](../codex/places.md#crystal-lake), explored [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's hidden garden, and shared lunch by a brook while poetically discussing nature. Priscilla later unexpectedly brought her aunt, the famous author Mrs. Charlotte E.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla became close friends with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) together. They share a romantic, imaginative sensibility, enjoying long woodland walks, picnic outings, and poetic discussions about nature and human souls. Priscilla also brings notable visitors to see [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), such as bringing her aunt, the famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a successful dinner and walk.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P7](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0007), +19 more_

- Friend of — close friend at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), +5 more</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) are friendly companions who participate in social outings together. They join [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on a spring picnic walk to celebrate Anne's unofficial birthday, exploring secluded woods, visiting the historic garden of [Hester Gray](../character/hester-gray.md), and dining by a brook before heading home at sunset.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P29](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0029), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P44](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0044), +5 more_

- Comrade of — friends participating together in a spring picnic and woodland exploration (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003)</sub>

### [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) is Priscilla's aunt and a famous author. Priscilla brings her aunt alongside Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) for an unexpected visit to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where they are hosted by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), +4 more_
